macro_f1.rule: |delta_macro_f1| >= 0.01 is considered material; |delta_macro_f1| < 0.01 is considered below predeclared materiality threshold

backdoor_detection.rule: |delta_backdoor_detections| >= 6 is considered material; |delta_backdoor_detections| < 6 is considered below predeclared practical materiality threshold

interpretation_contract: Practical effect materiality thresholds are distinct from statistical significance p-values and must not be altered post hoc.
